messages:
talia: FYI were seeing preview != finalizer for high-QPS batch routes after the adaptive-batcher rollout. Preview totals are higher for several tenants. Anyone on this?
igor: saw that too. Quick sample: preview counted a single batch (3 reqs) -> tokens=900, finalizer shows two batches (2 reqs + 1 req) and ended up with different sampling attribution.
build-bot: deployed adaptive-batcher v1.2 canary to us-west at 01:00 UTC
recon: prometheus check: `increase(invoice_preview_batched_tokens_total[10m]) vs increase(finalizer_batched_tokens_total[10m])` shows a 1.6% delta concentrated on chat-batch routes.
abby: hypothesis: preview uses event-time logical batching heuristics (prefix coalescing) while finalizer re-aggregates using processing-time windows after late-arrival corrections. The two batching boundaries produce different batch_ids -> different sampling decisions.
talia: short-term mitigation: finalizer can enable `use_preview_batching=true` for preview-hour reconciliation so it uses the same batcher snapshot. Can someone flip that for canary?
igor: I can flip the config in eu-west canary and run a diff job that computes `batch_hash(preview) == batch_hash(finalizer)` for sampled traffic.
build-bot: opened ENG-11021: adaptive-batcher parity toggle
abby: console UX: surface a "batching variance" column on invoice preview and a small tooltip explaining when re-aggregation may change counts. Also add an alert when `batch_hash_mismatch_rate > 0.5%`.
recon: pushed a dashboard card `batch_hash_mismatch_rate_by_route` and an alert to paging if it spikes.
talia: after toggling `use_preview_batching` in canary, mismatch for sampled tenants dropped from 1.6% -> 0.12%. Good signal.
igor: follow-ups: (1) unify batching logic into a shared library (ENG-11022) (2) add contract e2e that asserts batch hashes equal for synthetic reorder workloads (ENG-11023) (3) console ribbon for batching-variance (ENG-11024).
abby: leaving card on for 24h and notifying finance. Closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
